texts.text: The Dark Miners already have access to the current blockchain. They know exactly who every person in the country voted for. Total transparency has become their tool of control.
We have reports of entire families receiving death threats. Children, wives, parents... they are using the vote as a weapon of extortion.
This is our last chance to reclaim freedom.
We need you to build a new voting system in Compact where no one, not even us, can know who each citizen voted for.
If you fail, tomorrow thousands of people will have to choose between their life and their conscience. Time is running out. Are you ready to accept the mission?
